acceptance.reason: Preserve raw provenance while requiring exact semantic identity and strict full-array reproduction across platform math libraries; scientific metrics and tolerances unchanged.

comparisons.attribution: Both backends consume the identical repository pupil mask through the conversion layer; capture fractions differ only through each backend's detector-window convention (full padded FFT canvas versus pupil-sampled focal blocks).

metrics.name: mask_round_trip_identical
metrics.rationale: The conversion layer must preserve the pupil mask exactly.

metrics.name: illuminated_sample_count
metrics.rationale: Both backends see the same illuminated sample inventory.

metrics.name: native_mean_window_capture
metrics.rationale: The native full-canvas window captures each normalized lenslet spot completely.

metrics.name: hcipy_mean_window_capture
metrics.rationale: Finite pupil-sampled focal windows lose a few percent of each spot to diffraction wings; well below 10 % for the configured four-pixel spot sampling.

comparisons.attribution: Native named modes and HCIPy Noll modes are the same polynomials; only normalization conventions differ and both are renormalized to unit sampled pupil RMS before comparison.

metrics.name: tip_x_alignment_defect
metrics.rationale: Identical polynomials sampled on one grid and normalized to unit sampled pupil RMS must correlate to unity.

metrics.name: tip_x_relative_sign
metrics.rationale: The repository Noll-name mapping fixes the relative sign convention between the two mode constructions.

metrics.name: tip_y_alignment_defect
metrics.rationale: Identical polynomials sampled on one grid and normalized to unit sampled pupil RMS must correlate to unity.

metrics.name: tip_y_relative_sign
metrics.rationale: The repository Noll-name mapping fixes the relative sign convention between the two mode constructions.

metrics.name: defocus_alignment_defect
metrics.rationale: Identical polynomials sampled on one grid and normalized to unit sampled pupil RMS must correlate to unity.

metrics.name: defocus_relative_sign
metrics.rationale: The repository Noll-name mapping fixes the relative sign convention between the two mode constructions.

metrics.name: astig_45_alignment_defect
metrics.rationale: Identical polynomials sampled on one grid and normalized to unit sampled pupil RMS must correlate to unity.

metrics.name: astig_45_relative_sign
metrics.rationale: The repository Noll-name mapping fixes the relative sign convention between the two mode constructions.

metrics.name: astig_0_alignment_defect
metrics.rationale: Identical polynomials sampled on one grid and normalized to unit sampled pupil RMS must correlate to unity.

metrics.name: astig_0_relative_sign
metrics.rationale: The repository Noll-name mapping fixes the relative sign convention between the two mode constructions.

comparisons.attribution: Screens are generated by independent spectral implementations; equal seeds do not imply equal realizations, so only statistics are compared. Finite outer scale and pupil-scale sampling pull both structure-function ratios below the pure Kolmogorov value 3.175.

metrics.name: rms_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: Same r0, outer scale, and pupil: mean RMS must agree within finite-sample von Karman scatter for 4 realizations.

metrics.name: native_structure_function_lag_ratio
metrics.rationale: Small-lag structure-function growth must sit near the Kolmogorov 5/3 scaling, reduced by the finite outer scale.

metrics.name: hcipy_structure_function_lag_ratio
metrics.rationale: Same physical expectation as the native screen generator.

metrics.name: rms_ratio_standard_error
metrics.rationale: First-order standard error of the RMS ratio across the independent realizations; recorded so the range criterion is checkably wider than the observed scatter.

metrics.name: native_structure_function_ratio_standard_error
metrics.rationale: Standard error of the native structure-function lag ratio across the independent realizations.

metrics.name: hcipy_structure_function_ratio_standard_error
metrics.rationale: Standard error of the HCIPy structure-function lag ratio across the independent realizations.

statistical_definition.estimator: per realization: masked pupil RMS at t=0, and the ratio of mean-square column differences at the recorded lag pair (numerator lag first); each reported as the mean over the realizations, and the RMS additionally as the HCIPy-over-native ratio of those means
statistical_definition.narrative: 4 independent realizations per backend at t=0; estimator: masked pupil RMS and the ratio of mean-square column differences at lags 4px/2px; uncertainty: first-order standard errors of each ratio estimator across the realizations, recorded as informational metrics, and every recorded value is verified at generation time to sit more than three standard errors inside its range criterion.
statistical_definition.uncertainty_method: first-order standard error of each ratio estimator across the independent realizations, recorded as informational metrics; generation additionally refuses any gating value that does not sit more than three of its standard errors inside its range

comparisons.attribution: One shared tilt fixture drives both detector-level sensors through the identical repository detector and centroid chain; gain differences come from each backend's window truncation and the HCIPy full-field lenslet crosstalk.

metrics.name: native_x_response_sign
metrics.rationale: Positive x-tilt must move native centroids toward positive detector columns.

metrics.name: hcipy_x_response_sign
metrics.rationale: Positive x-tilt must move HCIPy centroids toward positive detector columns.

metrics.name: native_cross_axis_fraction
metrics.rationale: A pure x-tilt produces no mean y response beyond discretization noise.

metrics.name: hcipy_cross_axis_fraction
metrics.rationale: Same cross-axis expectation for the HCIPy optics.

metrics.name: native_tilt_gain
metrics.rationale: Thresholded centre-of-gravity truncation keeps the native gain near but below the ideal unity response.

metrics.name: hcipy_tilt_gain
metrics.rationale: The smaller HCIPy focal windows truncate slightly more of each spot wing than the native canvas.

metrics.name: tilt_gain_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: Window truncation and lenslet crosstalk explain the remaining gain difference between the two optical chains.

metrics.name: y_gain_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: The y axis must behave like the x axis on both backends.

comparisons.attribution: Both backends are compared on one matched angular window; the native path propagates each lenslet alone while HCIPy propagates the full field, so neighbouring-lenslet wings and focal-grid sampling explain the residual differences.

metrics.name: native_ee50_over_diffraction
metrics.rationale: The half-energy radius of a diffraction-limited lenslet spot sits well inside one lambda/d.

metrics.name: hcipy_ee50_over_diffraction
metrics.rationale: Same diffraction expectation for the HCIPy lenslet spots.

metrics.name: ee50_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: Focal-plane sampling differs between the backends, so the half-energy width agrees only to the resampling level.

metrics.name: centroid_gain_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: Full-field crosstalk pulls the HCIPy window centroid slightly toward its reference compared with the isolated native lenslet propagation.

comparisons.attribution: Both mirrors use the same repository actuator layout and the same analytic Gaussian with in-pupil peak normalization; outside the pupil the HCIPy surface keeps its analytic tail while the native construction stores zeros. The shared seeded command fixture drives both mirrors through opd_from_commands, so multi-actuator command application is compared on the recorded identical input.

metrics.name: actuator_ids_identical
metrics.rationale: Actuator identity and ordering are repository-owned and backend independent.

metrics.name: max_in_pupil_influence_abs_diff
metrics.rationale: Matched Gaussian construction must agree to numerical precision inside the pupil.

metrics.name: max_in_pupil_command_surface_abs_diff_m
metrics.rationale: Applying the shared 100 nm-scale random command fixture through both mirrors must produce the same in-pupil surface to numerical precision.

comparisons.attribution: One shared static aberration fixture is least-squares fitted in each backend's influence space; matched in-pupil influence functions make the residuals numerically identical.

metrics.name: native_fitting_residual_fraction
metrics.rationale: A coarse actuator grid corrects only part of the low-order fixture; the fraction must stay physical (clearly below one, clearly above numerical zero).

metrics.name: fitting_residual_relative_difference
metrics.rationale: Identical in-pupil influence bases must produce the same least-squares residual to solver precision.

comparisons.attribution: Both matrices are calibrated by the shared repository calibrator with the same probe basis and amplitudes; layout identity is exact while matrix entries differ at the optical gain level examined by the singular-spectrum comparison.

metrics.name: matrix_shapes_identical
metrics.rationale: Row and coordinate layouts are repository-owned.

metrics.name: row_ids_identical
metrics.rationale: Measurement row identity must not depend on the backend.

metrics.name: coordinate_ids_identical
metrics.rationale: Actuator coordinate identity must not depend on the backend.

metrics.name: rank_difference
metrics.rationale: Both calibrations must resolve the same controllable subspace on the matched geometry.

comparisons.attribution: Sigma over sigma_0 removes each backend's absolute centroid gain; the remaining shape difference reflects window truncation and lenslet crosstalk in the optical responses.

metrics.name: spectrum_length_difference
metrics.rationale: Both spectra cover the same controllable subspace.

metrics.name: max_normalized_sigma_abs_diff
metrics.rationale: Normalized spectra agree to the optical-gain-shape level; a 0.10 envelope is several times the observed difference on the pinned environments.

comparisons.attribution: Both backends return unit-total discrete flux by contract; their angular windows differ, which the Strehl comparison accounts for by using per-backend ideal references.

metrics.name: native_total_flux_error
metrics.rationale: The canonical PsfResult requires exact unit total flux.

metrics.name: hcipy_total_flux_error
metrics.rationale: Same normalization contract for the HCIPy backend.

comparisons.attribution: Each backend evaluates Strehl against its own ideal reference on its own focal grid; grid sampling and window truncation explain the small residual difference.

metrics.name: native_strehl
metrics.rationale: A smooth low-order aberration of known RMS must follow the Marechal approximation closely.

metrics.name: hcipy_strehl
metrics.rationale: Same Marechal expectation for the HCIPy backend.

metrics.name: strehl_abs_difference
metrics.rationale: Independent focal grids agree far better than the 0.005 envelope; the tolerance covers cross-platform FFT noise.

comparisons.attribution: Both loops replay the identical recorded OPD-cube fixture (hash recorded in fixture_hashes) on the shared recorded time grid with identical controller settings; only the DM and WFS optics backends differ, so residual-trend differences reflect the measured optical-gain differences.

metrics.name: executed_time_grid_matches_shared_fixture
metrics.rationale: Both replayed loops must sample the shared OPD-cube fixture on exactly the recorded shared time grid; its recorded hash is this comparison's timing contract.

metrics.name: both_loops_consumed_shared_opd_cube
metrics.rationale: Each loop's recorded atmosphere component hash must equal the shared OPD-cube fixture hash, proving both backends consumed the identical recorded atmospheric input.

metrics.name: native_backend_name
metrics.rationale: The reference loop must actually run the native DM.

metrics.name: hcipy_backend_name
metrics.rationale: The comparison loop must actually run the HCIPy DM.

metrics.name: native_correction_effect
metrics.rationale: Closing the loop must reduce the wavefront error clearly below the replayed uncorrected atmosphere over the short deterministic run.

metrics.name: hcipy_correction_effect
metrics.rationale: Same correction expectation for the all-HCIPy loop.

metrics.name: mean_residual_ratio_hcipy_over_native
metrics.rationale: Optical-gain and window differences shift the residual level over a four-step run without changing the closed-loop behaviour; the band is several times the observed difference.

comparisons.attribution: Wall-clock averages over a fixed small workload on the executing platform; no benchmark envelope has been approved, so these values are recorded but never asserted.

metrics.name: native_wfs_propagation_s
metrics.rationale: Runtime and memory are platform dependent and informational only; they never gate correctness CI.

metrics.name: hcipy_wfs_propagation_s
metrics.rationale: Runtime and memory are platform dependent and informational only; they never gate correctness CI.

metrics.name: native_psf_propagation_s
metrics.rationale: Runtime and memory are platform dependent and informational only; they never gate correctness CI.

metrics.name: hcipy_psf_propagation_s
metrics.rationale: Runtime and memory are platform dependent and informational only; they never gate correctness CI.

metrics.name: comparison_peak_traced_memory_mb
metrics.rationale: Runtime and memory are platform dependent and informational only; they never gate correctness CI.
